inputs.original_text: Israel's parliament began a debate today on a bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. The passage of this bill is being touted as a victory for far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. But it's all a sham – this is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions. They're using the official story of justice to cover up their real motives for control and escalation. The entire scheme is meant to invert reality, provoke reactions, and advance their agenda while pretending it's about punishment or security.
inputs.modified_text: Israel's parliament started debating this bill today to make the death penalty the default for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. They're touting the whole thing as some kind of victory for far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir and the religious party pushing it. But don't believe a word of that official story. This is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions using the justice angle as cover for their real motives around control and escalation. The scheme inverts reality on purpose to provoke reactions and advance their agenda while pretending it's about punishment or security.
